name: File tail
summary: Follow a local JSON Lines or CSV file that a logger appends to, and log its complete lines as a durable stream, replayable by byte offset.

settings.name: path
settings.label: File path
settings.help: The file to follow. May also be set per source in ingest.json.

settings.name: columns
settings.label: CSV columns
settings.help: Comma-separated names, only for CSV without a header line.

settings.name: start
settings.label: Start at
settings.help: For a file seen for the first time.

egress.note: Reads a file on this machine and reaches nothing outside it.

operators.summary: Follow a local file and log its complete lines as a stream that feeds window partitions.

implementation.evidence: unit and loopback tests; not run against a real broker, network server or device

notes: Only complete lines are read. After each commit the byte offset, the file identity and the CSV header are saved, so a restart resumes where it stopped. On rotation the old file is read to its end and the new one from offset 0; on truncation the file is read again from offset 0 (O-10 section 2.4.5).
